    overall: '這是預覽模式的示範結果。正式環境會顯示 AI 依評分規準給你的回饋。',
    per: [
      { no: 1, id: 'Q-M501', text: DEMO_DATA.questions[0].text, score: 10, max: 10, dims: '算式與通分:滿、計算正確:滿、說明:滿',
        feedback: '（示範）通分過程清楚，答案 5/12 公升正確。',
        solution: '3/4 − 1/3 = 9/12 − 4/12 = 5/12（公升）。4 和 3 的最小公倍數是 12，所以把兩個分數都通分成分母 12，再把分子相減。' },
      { no: 2, id: 'Q-M502', text: DEMO_DATA.questions[1].text, score: 5, max: 10, dims: '圖示說明:½、正確答案:½',
        feedback: '（示範）有指出分母不能直接相加，但圖沒有畫成相同等分，答案也還沒寫出 5/6。',
        solution: '分母代表把一個整體平分成幾份，不能直接相加。1/2 = 3/6、1/3 = 2/6，所以 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6。可用切成 6 等分的長條圖或圓形圖說明。' }
    ]
  };

  var state = { data: null, boards: [], activeBoard: null, textBoard: null, submitted: false, busy: false, currentUnit: '' };

  /* ==============================================================
   *  工具
   * ============================================================== */
  function $(sel, root) { return (root || document).querySelector(sel); }
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
    });
  }
  function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, ms); }); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v)); }

  var toastTimer = null;
  function toast(msg, type) {
    var el = $('#toast');
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.className = 'fixed left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-24 z-[60] max-w-[90vw] px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm text-white shadow-lg ' +
      (type === 'error' ? 'bg-rust' : type === 'ok' ? 'bg-forest' : 'bg-ink');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function () { el.classList.add('hidden'); }, 2800);
  }

  function callServer(fn, arg) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var runner = google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(resolve).withFailureHandler(reject);
      if (arg === undefined) runner[fn](); else runner[fn](arg);
    });
  }

  function storageGet(k) { try { return window.localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
  function storageSet(k, v) { try { window.localStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ } }

  /** 依畫布寬度自動折行：英數字詞保持完整，中文逐字斷行，並避免標點出現在行首 */
  function wrapText(ctx, text, maxW) {
    var out = [];
    String(text).replace(/\r/g, '').split('\n').forEach(function (para) {
      if (para === '') { out.push(''); return; }
      var tokens = para.match(/[A-Za-z0-9\u00C0-\u024F'’_\-.]+|\s+|[\s\S]/g) || [];
      var line = '';
      tokens.forEach(function (tok) {
        if (ctx.measureText(line + tok).width <= maxW) { line += tok; return; }
        if (tok.length === 1 && NO_LINE_START.indexOf(tok) >= 0 && line) { line += tok; return; }
        if (/^\s+$/.test(tok)) { if (line) { out.push(line.replace(/\s+$/, '')); line = ''; } return; }
        if (line.trim()) { out.push(line.replace(/\s+$/, '')); line = ''; }
        if (ctx.measureText(tok).width > maxW) {
          Array.from(tok).forEach(function (ch) {
            if (line && ctx.measureText(line + ch).width > maxW) { out.push(line); line = ch; }
            else line += ch;
          });
        } else {
          line = tok;
        }
      });
      out.push(line.replace(/\s+$/, ''));
    });
    return out;
  }

  function fitText(ctx, text, maxW) {
    if (ctx.measureText(text).width <= maxW) return text;
    var chars = Array.from(text);
    while (chars.length && ctx.measureText(chars.join('') + '…').width > maxW) chars.pop();
    return chars.join('') + '…';
  }

  /* ==============================================================
   *  CanvasBoard：一題一塊畫布
   * ============================================================== */
  function CanvasBoard(question, index) {
    this.q = question;
    this.index = index;
    this.tool = 'pen';
    this.color = INKS[1].color;
    this.size = 3;
    this.history = [];
    this.hasContent = false;
    this.drawing = false;
    this.pointerId = null;
    this.last = null;
    this.lastMid = null;
    this.textPos = null;
    this.caret = null;
    this.floating = null;
    this.el = this.render();
  }

  CanvasBoard.prototype.render = function () {
    var q = this.q, n = this.index + 1;
    var el = document.createElement('article');
    el.className = 'card overflow-hidden';
    var swatches = INKS.map(function (k, i) {
      return '<button type="button" class="swatch' + (i === 1 ? ' active' : '') + '" title="' + esc(k.name) + '" data-color="' + k.color + '" style="background:' + k.color + '"></button>';
    }).join('');
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="px-4 sm:px-5 pt-4 pb-3 border-b border-line">' +
        '<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-2">' +
          '<span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-ink text-white text-sm font-bold">第 ' + n + ' 題</span>' +
          (q.grade ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-paper border border-line text-xs">' + esc(q.grade) + '</span>' : '') +
          (q.subject ? '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-paper border border-line text-xs">' + esc(q.subject) + '</span>' : '') +
          '<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-forest/10 text-forest text-xs font-semibold">' + esc(q.score) + ' 分</span>' +
          '<span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-slatey">' + esc(q.id) + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<p class="font-serif text-[1.05rem] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">' + esc(q.text) + '</p>' +
        (q.imageUrl ? '<img src="' + esc(q.imageUrl) + '" alt="題目附圖" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" class="mt-3 max-h-72 rounded-lg border border-line">' : '') +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="px-3 sm:px-4 py-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-paper/50 border-b border-line">' +
        '<button type="button" class="tool-btn active" data-tool="pen">✏️ 畫筆</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="tool-btn" data-tool="eraser">🧽 橡皮擦</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="tool-btn" data-tool="text">🔤 插入文字</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="tool-btn" data-act="image">🖼️ 上傳圖片</button>' +
        '<input type="file" accept="image/*" class="hidden" data-role="file">' +
        '<span class="w-px h-6 bg-line mx-1 hidden sm:inline-block"></span>' +
        '<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">' + swatches + '</div>' +
        '<label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm ml-1">粗細' +
          '<input type="range" min="1" max="24" value="3" data-role="size" class="w-24">' +
          '<span data-role="sizeLabel" class="w-5 text-right tabular-nums">3</span></label>' +
        '<span class="flex-1"></span>' +
        '<button type="button" class="tool-btn" data-act="undo" disabled>↩️ 復原</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="tool-btn" data-act="clear">🗑️ 清空</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="p-3 sm:p-4">' +
        '<p data-role="hint" class="text-xs text-slatey mb-2">✏️ 用手指、觸控筆或滑鼠在下方作答。</p>' +
        '<div class="board-wrap"><canvas></canvas></div>' +
        '<div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">' +
          '<button type="button" class="tool-btn !border-dashed !border-forest !text-forest" data-act="expand">➕ 增加畫布空間（+' + EXPAND_STEP + 'px）</button>' +
          '<span data-role="sizeInfo" class="text-xs text-slatey"></span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    return el;
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.mount = function (parent) {
    parent.appendChild(this.el);
    var self = this, el = this.el;
    this.wrap = $('.board-wrap', el);
    this.canvas = $('canvas', el);
    this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    this.hint = $('[data-role=hint]', el);

    el.querySelectorAll('[data-tool]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { self.setTool(b.dataset.tool); });
    });
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { self.setColor(b.dataset.color); });
    });
    var range = $('[data-role=size]', el), sizeLabel = $('[data-role=sizeLabel]', el);
    range.addEventListener('input', function () { self.size = Number(range.value); sizeLabel.textContent = range.value; });

    var fileInput = $('[data-role=file]', el);
    $('[data-act=image]', el).addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (self.floating) return toast('請先確認或取消目前的圖片');
      fileInput.click();
    });
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
      var f = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
      e.target.value = '';
      if (f) self.loadImageFile(f);
    });
    $('[data-act=undo]', el).addEventListener('click', function () { self.undo(); });
    $('[data-act=clear]', el).addEventListener('click', function () { self.clear(); });
    $('[data-act=expand]', el).addEventListener('click', function () { self.expand(EXPAND_STEP); });

    var c = this.canvas;
    c.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { self.onDown(e); });
    c.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { self.onMove(e); });
    c.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { self.onUp(e); });
    c.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (e) { self.onUp(e); });
    c.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

    this.initCanvas();
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.initCanvas = function () {
    var w = Math.max(320, Math.round(this.wrap.clientWidth || 720));
    this.canvas.width = Math.round(w * DPR);
    this.canvas.height = Math.round(BASE_HEIGHT * DPR);
    this.fillWhite();
    this.updateSizeInfo();
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.fillWhite = function () {
    var ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);
    ctx.restore();
  };

  /** 畫布像素 ÷ 螢幕 CSS 像素 */
  CanvasBoard.prototype.ratio = function () {
    var r = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width ? this.canvas.width / r.width : DPR;
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.pt = function (e) {
    var r = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    var k = this.canvas.width / r.width;
    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * k, y: (e.clientY - r.top) * k };
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.setTool = function (tool) {
    if (this.floating) return toast('請先確認或取消目前的圖片');
    this.tool = tool;
    this.el.querySelectorAll('[data-tool]').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tool === tool); });
    this.wrap.classList.toggle('mode-text', tool === 'text');
    if (tool !== 'text') this.removeCaret();
    this.hint.textContent = tool === 'text' ? '👆 點一下畫布，選擇文字要開始的位置。'
      : tool === 'eraser' ? '🧽 橡皮擦：擦過的地方會變回白色。'
      : '✏️ 用手指、觸控筆或滑鼠在下方作答。';
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.setColor = function (color) {
    this.color = color;
    this.el.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.color === color); });
    if (this.tool === 'eraser') this.setTool('pen');
  };

  /* ---------- 手寫 ---------- */
  CanvasBoard.prototype.applyStroke = function (ev) {
    var ctx = this.ctx;
    var pressure = (ev.pointerType === 'pen' && ev.pressure > 0) ? (0.4 + ev.pressure * 1.2) : 1;
    var base = this.tool === 'eraser' ? Math.max(this.size * 4, 16) : this.size;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = this.tool === 'eraser' ? '#ffffff' : this.color;
    ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle;
    ctx.lineWidth = base * DPR * pressure;
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.onDown = function (e) {
    state.activeBoard = this;
    if (this.floating) return;
    if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
    var p = this.pt(e);

    if (this.tool === 'text') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this.placeCaret(p);
      openTextModal(this);
      return;
    }
    if (this.pointerId !== null) return; // 忽略第二根手指
    e.preventDefault();
    this.pointerId = e.pointerId;
    try { this.canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* 忽略 */ }
    this.pushHistory();
    this.drawing = true;
    this.last = p;
    this.lastMid = p;
    this.applyStroke(e);
    var ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, ctx.lineWidth / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    this.markDirty();
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.onMove = function (e) {
    if (!this.drawing || e.pointerId !== this.pointerId) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var self = this, ctx = this.ctx;
    var evs = (e.getCoalescedEvents && e.getCoalescedEvents()) || [];
    if (!evs.length) evs = [e];
    evs.forEach(function (ev) {
      var p = self.pt(ev);
      var mid = { x: (self.last.x + p.x) / 2, y: (self.last.y + p.y) / 2 };
      self.applyStroke(ev);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(self.lastMid.x, self.lastMid.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(self.last.x, self.last.y, mid.x, mid.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      self.last = p;
      self.lastMid = mid;
    });
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.onUp = function (e) {
    if (e.pointerId !== this.pointerId) return;
    if (this.drawing && this.last) {
      var ctx = this.ctx;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(this.lastMid.x, this.lastMid.y);
      ctx.lineTo(this.last.x, this.last.y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    this.drawing = false;
    this.pointerId = null;
  };

  /* ---------- 復原／清空 ---------- */
  CanvasBoard.prototype.pushHistory = function () {
    try {
      this.history.push({ w: this.canvas.width, h: this.canvas.height, data: this.ctx.getImageData(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height) });
      if (this.history.length > HISTORY_LIMIT) this.history.shift();
    } catch (err) { /* 記憶體不足時略過 */ }
    this.updateUndo();
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.updateUndo = function () {
    $('[data-act=undo]', this.el).disabled = this.history.length === 0;
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.undo = function () {
    var snap = this.history.pop();
    if (!snap) return toast('沒有可以復原的步驟');
    if (snap.w !== this.canvas.width || snap.h !== this.canvas.height) {
      this.canvas.width = snap.w;
      this.canvas.height = snap.h;
    }
    this.ctx.putImageData(snap.data, 0, 0);
    this.updateSizeInfo();
    this.updateUndo();
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.clear = function () {
    if (!window.confirm('確定要清空第 ' + (this.index + 1) + ' 題的畫布嗎？（可用「↩️ 復原」救回）')) return;
    this.pushHistory();
    this.fillWhite();
    this.hasContent = false;
    updateProgress();
  };

  /* ---------- ➕ 增加畫布空間（絕不清空既有筆跡） ---------- */
  CanvasBoard.prototype.expand = function (cssPx, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    if (!opts.noHistory) this.pushHistory();
    var add = Math.round(cssPx * DPR);

    // 1) 先把目前畫面完整備份到 tempCanvas
    var temp = document.createElement('canvas');
    temp.width = this.canvas.width;
    temp.height = this.canvas.height;
    temp.getContext('2d').drawImage(this.canvas, 0, 0);

    // 2) 改變高度（瀏覽器會在此時清空畫布並重設 ctx 狀態）
    this.canvas.height = this.canvas.height + add;

    // 3) 重新鋪白底，再把備份原封不動貼回
    this.fillWhite();
    this.ctx.drawImage(temp, 0, 0);

    temp.width = temp.height = 0; // 釋放記憶體
    this.updateSizeInfo();
    if (!opts.silent) toast('已增加 ' + cssPx + 'px 畫布空間，原有筆跡完整保留', 'ok');
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.updateSizeInfo = function () {
    $('[data-role=sizeInfo]', this.el).textContent = '目前畫布高度：' + Math.round(this.canvas.height / DPR) + ' px';
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.markDirty = function () {
    if (!this.hasContent) { this.hasContent = true; updateProgress(); }
  };

  /* ---------- 🔤 插入文字 ---------- */
  CanvasBoard.prototype.placeCaret = function (p) {
    this.textPos = p;
    this.removeCaret();
    var k = this.ratio();
    var caret = document.createElement('div');
    caret.className = 'text-caret';
    caret.style.left = (p.x / k) + 'px';
    caret.style.top = (p.y / k - 12) + 'px';
    caret.style.height = '24px';
    this.wrap.appendChild(caret);
    this.caret = caret;
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.removeCaret = function () {
    if (this.caret && this.caret.parentNode) this.caret.parentNode.removeChild(this.caret);
    this.caret = null;
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.commitText = function (text, fontCss) {
    var self = this;
    if (!text.trim() || !this.textPos) { this.removeCaret(); return Promise.resolve(); }
    var fs = Math.round(fontCss * DPR);
    var fontReady = (document.fonts && document.fonts.load)
      ? document.fonts.load(fs + 'px "Noto Sans TC"').catch(function () {}) : Promise.resolve();

    return fontReady.then(function () {
      var ctx = self.ctx;
      var margin = Math.round(14 * DPR);
      var lineH = Math.round(fs * 1.45);
      var x = self.textPos.x;
      var y = Math.max(margin / 2, self.textPos.y - fs / 2);

      ctx.font = fs + 'px ' + CANVAS_FONT;
      var maxW = self.canvas.width - x - margin;
      if (maxW < fs * 4) { x = margin; maxW = self.canvas.width - margin * 2; }
      var lines = wrapText(ctx, text, maxW);

      self.pushHistory();
      // 文字超出底部時自動增加畫布（同樣走備份貼回流程）
      while (y + lines.length * lineH + margin > self.canvas.height) {
        self.expand(EXPAND_STEP, { noHistory: true, silent: true });
      }

      // 調整高度會重設 ctx，因此字型與顏色要在這之後設定
      ctx.font = fs + 'px ' + CANVAS_FONT;
      ctx.fillStyle = self.color;
      ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
      lines.forEach(function (ln, i) { ctx.fillText(ln, x, y + i * lineH); });

      self.removeCaret();
      self.textPos = null;
      self.markDirty();
      toast('文字已印上畫布（共 ' + lines.length + ' 行）', 'ok');
    });
  };

  /* ---------- 🖼️ 上傳圖片註記 ---------- */
  CanvasBoard.prototype.loadImageFile = function (file) {
    var self = this;
    if (!/^image\//.test(file.type)) return toast('請選擇圖片檔', 'error');
    if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) return toast('圖片太大（上限 15MB）', 'error');
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function () {
      var img = new Image();
      img.onload = function () { self.createFloating(img); };
      img.onerror = function () { toast('無法讀取這張圖片', 'error'); };
      img.src = reader.result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.createFloating = function (img) {
    var self = this;
    var wrapW = this.wrap.clientWidth, wrapH = this.wrap.clientHeight;
    var ratio = img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight;
    var w = Math.min(wrapW * 0.6, img.naturalWidth);
    var h = w / ratio;
    if (h > wrapH * 0.8) { h = wrapH * 0.8; w = h * ratio; }
    var rect = this.wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    var top = clamp(-rect.top + 110, 8, Math.max(8, wrapH - h - 8));
    var left = (wrapW - w) / 2;

    var box = document.createElement('div');
    box.className = 'float-img';
    box.innerHTML =
      '<img alt="">' +
      '<div class="float-actions">' +
        '<button type="button" data-f="ok" class="bg-forest text-white">✔ 印上畫布</button>' +
        '<button type="button" data-f="cancel" class="bg-white text-ink">✖ 取消</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="resize-handle" title="拖曳縮放"></div>';
    $('img', box).src = img.src;
    this.wrap.appendChild(box);

    this.floating = { box: box, img: img, ratio: ratio, x: left, y: top, w: w, h: h, drag: null };
    this.layoutFloating();
    this.hint.textContent = '🖼️ 拖曳圖片調整位置、拉右下角縮放，完成後按「✔ 印上畫布」。';

    $('[data-f=ok]', box).addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); self.confirmFloating(); });
    $('[data-f=cancel]', box).addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); self.cancelFloating(); });

    box.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
      if (e.target.closest('button')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var f = self.floating;
      f.drag = {
        mode: e.target.classList.contains('resize-handle') ? 'resize' : 'move',
        px: e.clientX, py: e.clientY, x: f.x, y: f.y, w: f.w, h: f.h, id: e.pointerId
      };
      try { box.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* 忽略 */ }
    });
    box.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      var f = self.floating;
      if (!f || !f.drag || e.pointerId !== f.drag.id) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      var W = self.wrap.clientWidth, H = self.wrap.clientHeight;
      var dx = e.clientX - f.drag.px, dy = e.clientY - f.drag.py;
      if (f.drag.mode === 'move') {
        f.x = clamp(f.drag.x + dx, 0, Math.max(0, W - f.w));
        f.y = clamp(f.drag.y + dy, 0, Math.max(0, H - f.h));
      } else {
        var nw = clamp(f.drag.w + Math.max(dx, dy * f.ratio), 40, W - f.x);
        var nh = nw / f.ratio;
        if (f.y + nh > H) { nh = H - f.y; nw = nh * f.ratio; }
        f.w = nw; f.h = nh;
      }
      self.layoutFloating();
    });
    var end = function (e) { var f = self.floating; if (f && f.drag && e.pointerId === f.drag.id) f.drag = null; };
    box.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
    box.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.layoutFloating = function () {
    var f = this.floating;
    f.box.style.left = f.x + 'px';
    f.box.style.top = f.y + 'px';
    f.box.style.width = f.w + 'px';
    f.box.style.height = f.h + 'px';
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.confirmFloating = function () {
    var f = this.floating;
    if (!f) return;
    var k = this.canvas.width / this.wrap.clientWidth;
    this.pushHistory();
    this.ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    this.ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    this.ctx.drawImage(f.img, f.x * k, f.y * k, f.w * k, f.h * k);
    f.box.remove();
    this.floating = null;
    this.markDirty();
    this.setTool(this.tool);
    toast('圖片已印上畫布，可以在上面繼續註記', 'ok');
  };

  CanvasBoard.prototype.cancelFloating = function () {
    if (!this.floating) return;
    this.floating.box.remove();
    this.floating = null;
    this.setTool(this.tool);
  };

  /* ==============================================================
   *  文字視窗
   * ============================================================== */
  function openTextModal(board) {
    state.textBoard = board;
    var m = $('#textModal');
    $('#textTarget').textContent = '第 ' + (board.index + 1) + ' 題';
    $('#textColorDot').style.background = board.color;
    var saved = storageGet('canvas35_fontsize');
    if (saved) $('#textSize').value = saved;
    $('#textInput').value = '';
    m.classList.remove('hidden');
    m.classList.add('flex');
    setTimeout(function () { $('#textInput').focus(); }, 30);
  }

  function closeTextModal(commit) {
    var m = $('#textModal');
    var board = state.textBoard;
    m.classList.add('hidden');
    m.classList.remove('flex');
    if (!board) return;
    if (commit) {
      var size = Number($('#textSize').value) || 24;
      storageSet('canvas35_fontsize', String(size));
      board.commitText($('#textInput').value, size);
    } else {
      board.removeCaret();
      board.textPos = null;
    }
    state.textBoard = null;
  }

  /* ==============================================================
   *  題目渲染與進度
   * ============================================================== */
  function unitsOf(questions) {
    var seen = [];
    questions.forEach(function (q) { if (seen.indexOf(q.unit) < 0) seen.push(q.unit); });
    return seen;
  }

  function renderUnit(unit) {
    var list = $('#questionList');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    state.boards = [];
    state.currentUnit = unit;
    state.submitted = false;
    var qs = state.data.questions.filter(function (q) { return q.unit === unit; });
    if (!qs.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-6 text-center text-slatey">這個單元目前沒有題目。</div>';
    }
    qs.forEach(function (q, i) {
      var b = new CanvasBoard(q, i);
      b.mount(list);
      state.boards.push(b);
    });
    updateProgress();
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    var total = state.boards.length;
    var done = state.boards.filter(function (b) { return b.hasContent; }).length;
    $('#progressText').textContent = total ? ('已作答 ' + done + '／' + total + ' 題' + (state.submitted ? '・已送出 ✅' : '')) : '沒有題目';
  }

  function readStudentInfo() {
    var info = {
      className: $('#inClass').value.trim(),
      seatNo: $('#inSeat').value.trim(),
      name: $('#inName').value.trim(),
      unit: state.currentUnit
    };
    if (!info.className || !info.seatNo || !info.name) {
      toast('請先填寫班級、座號與姓名', 'error');
      (!info.className ? $('#inClass') : !info.seatNo ? $('#inSeat') : $('#inName')).focus();
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      return null;
    }
    storageSet('canvas35_student', JSON.stringify({ c: info.className, s: info.seatNo, n: info.name }));
    return info;
  }

  /* ==============================================================
   *  📤 送出：所有題目畫布垂直拼接 → Base64
   * ============================================================== */
  function composeBoards(boards, info) {
    var PAD = 24, INFO_H = 60, HEADER = 64, GAP = 28, MAX_H = 15000;

    function plan(W) {
      var inner = W - PAD * 2;
      var items = boards.map(function (b) { return { b: b, h: Math.round(b.canvas.height * inner / b.canvas.width) }; });
      var total = PAD + INFO_H + items.reduce(function (s, it) { return s + HEADER + it.h; }, 0) + GAP * (items.length - 1) + PAD;
      return { W: W, inner: inner, items: items, total: total };
    }

    var L = plan(1200);
    if (L.total > MAX_H) L = plan(Math.max(600, Math.floor(1200 * MAX_H / L.total)));

    var out = document.createElement('canvas');
    out.width = L.W;
    out.height = L.total;
    var c = out.getContext('2d');
    c.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    c.fillRect(0, 0, out.width, out.height);
    c.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    c.textBaseline = 'middle';

    // 學生資料列
    var now = new Date();
    var stamp = now.getFullYear() + '/' + (now.getMonth() + 1) + '/' + now.getDate() + ' ' +
      String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    c.fillStyle = '#243b53';
    c.font = 'bold 24px ' + CANVAS_FONT;
    c.fillText(fitText(c, info.className + ' 班　' + info.seatNo + ' 號　' + info.name, L.inner * 0.55), PAD, PAD + INFO_H / 2 - 4);
    c.font = '18px ' + CANVAS_FONT;
    c.fillStyle = '#627d98';
    c.textAlign = 'right';
    c.fillText(fitText(c, '單元：' + info.unit + '｜' + stamp, L.inner * 0.43), PAD + L.inner, PAD + INFO_H / 2 - 4);
    c.textAlign = 'left';
    c.fillStyle = '#2d6a4f';
    c.fillRect(PAD, PAD + INFO_H - 10, L.inner, 3);

    var y = PAD + INFO_H;
    var layout = [];
    L.items.forEach(function (it, i) {
      var top = y;
      c.fillStyle = '#243b53';
      c.fillRect(PAD, y, L.inner, HEADER);
      c.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      c.font = 'bold 26px ' + CANVAS_FONT;
      c.fillText('第 ' + (i + 1) + ' 題', PAD + 18, y + HEADER / 2);
      c.font = '17px ' + CANVAS_FONT;
      c.fillStyle = '#d9e2ec';
      c.fillText(fitText(c, it.b.q.id + '｜' + it.b.q.text.replace(/\s+/g, ' '), L.inner - 160), PAD + 130, y + HEADER / 2);
      y += HEADER;
      c.drawImage(it.b.canvas, PAD, y, L.inner, it.h);
      c.strokeStyle = '#cfcac0';
      c.lineWidth = 2;
      c.strokeRect(PAD, top, L.inner, HEADER + it.h);
      y += it.h;
      layout.push({
        questionId: it.b.q.id, index: i + 1,
        topPct: Math.round(top / L.total * 1000) / 10,
        bottomPct: Math.round(y / L.total * 1000) / 10
      });
      y += GAP;
    });

    return { dataUrl: out.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.88), layout: layout };
  }

  function setBusy(on, label) {
    state.busy = on;
    $('#btnSubmit').disabled = on || !state.data || !state.data.settings.open || !state.boards.length;
    $('#submitSpin').classList.toggle('hidden', !on);
    $('#submitLabel').textContent = on ? (label || '處理中…') : '📤 送出作業';
  }

  function showResult(ok, comp, title, msg) {
    $('#resultIcon').textContent = ok ? '✅' : '⚠️';
    $('#resultTitle').textContent = title;
    $('#resultMsg').textContent = msg;
    $('#resultImg').src = comp ? comp.dataUrl : '';
    $('#resultDownload').href = comp ? comp.dataUrl : '#';
    var m = $('#resultModal');
    m.classList.remove('hidden');
    m.classList.add('flex');
  }

  function handleSubmit() {
    if (state.busy) return;
    var info = readStudentInfo();
    if (!info) return;
    var boards = state.boards;
    if (!boards.length) return toast('沒有題目可以送出', 'error');
    if (boards.some(function (b) { return b.floating; })) return toast('還有圖片尚未「✔ 印上畫布」或取消', 'error');
    var blank = boards.filter(function (b) { return !b.hasContent; }).map(function (b) { return b.index + 1; });
    if (blank.length && !window.confirm('第 ' + blank.join('、') + ' 題還沒作答，仍要送出嗎？')) return;
    if (state.submitted && !window.confirm('你已經送出過一次，確定要再送出一份新的作答嗎？')) return;

    setBusy(true, '正在合成作答圖…');
    sleep(30).then(function () {
      var comp = composeBoards(boards, info);
      var payload = {
        className: info.className, seatNo: info.seatNo, name: info.name, unit: info.unit,
        questionIds: boards.map(function (b) { return b.q.id; }),
        imageData: comp.dataUrl,
        layout: comp.layout
      };
      if (IS_GAS) {
        setBusy(true, '正在上傳…');
        return callServer('submitAnswer', payload).then(function (res) {
          state.submitted = true;
          showResult(true, comp, '作業已送出', '送出時間：' + res.submittedAt + '。老師批改後會在試算表看到 AI 回饋。');
        });
      }
      return sleep(700).then(function () {
        state.submitted = true;
        var kb = Math.round(comp.dataUrl.length * 0.75 / 1024);
        showResult(true, comp, '預覽模式：已產生合成圖',
          '共 ' + boards.length + ' 題垂直拼接，Base64 約 ' + kb + ' KB。正式環境會把這張圖傳給後端存檔，並交由 Gemini 批改。');
      });
    }).catch(function (err) {
      toast('送出失敗：' + ((err && err.message) || err), 'error');
    }).then(function () {
      setBusy(false);
      updateProgress();
    });
  }

  /* ==============================================================
   *  🔍 查詢成績與詳解
   * ============================================================== */
  function switchView(view) {
    var isQuery = view === 'query';
    $('#viewAnswer').classList.toggle('hidden', isQuery);
    $('#submitBar').classList.toggle('hidden', isQuery);
    $('#viewQuery').classList.toggle('hidden', !isQuery);
    $('#tabAnswer').classList.toggle('active', !isQuery);
    $('#tabQuery').classList.toggle('active', isQuery);
    $('#tabAnswer').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isQuery));
    $('#tabQuery').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isQuery));
    if (isQuery) {
      // 沿用作答頁已填的資料
      if (!$('#qClass').value) $('#qClass').value = $('#inClass').value;
      if (!$('#qSeat').value) $('#qSeat').value = $('#inSeat').value;
      if (!$('#qName').value) $('#qName').value = $('#inName').value;
      if (state.currentUnit) $('#qUnit').value = state.currentUnit;
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function setQueryBusy(on) {
    $('#btnQuery').disabled = on;
    $('#querySpin').classList.toggle('hidden', !on);
    $('#queryLabel').textContent = on ? '查詢中…' : '查詢成績';
  }

  function fmtNum(n) { return n === null || n === undefined || n === '' ? '－' : (Math.round(Number(n) * 100) / 100); }

  function renderQueryResult(res, info) {
    var box = $('#qResult');
    if (!res || !res.found) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-6 text-center">' +
        '<div class="text-3xl mb-2">🔎</div>' +
        '<p class="font-bold">找不到你在「' + esc(info.unit) + '」的作答紀錄</p>' +
        '<p class="text-sm text-slatey mt-1">請確認班級、座號、姓名和送出作業時相同；如果還沒送出，請先到「📝 開始作答」完成作業。</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    if (!res.done) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="card p-6">' +
        '<div class="flex items-start gap-3"><div class="text-3xl">⏳</div><div>' +
        '<p class="font-bold">作業已收到，老師還在批改中</p>' +
        '<p class="text-sm text-slatey mt-1">單元：' + esc(res.unit) + '｜送出時間：' + esc(res.submittedAt) + '｜目前狀態：' + esc(res.status || '待批改') + '</p>' +
        '<p class="text-sm text-slatey mt-1">批改完成後再回來查詢就能看到分數與回饋。</p></div></div></div>';
      return;
    }

    var pct = res.max ? Math.round(res.total / res.max * 100) : 0;
    var html = '<section class="card p-5 sm:p-6">' +
      '<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5">' +
        '<div class="score-ring shrink-0 w-28 h-28 rounded-full grid place-items-center text-center" style="background:conic-gradient(#2d6a4f ' + pct + '%, #e4e1da 0)">' +
          '<div class="w-[5.6rem] h-[5.6rem] rounded-full bg-card grid place-items-center">' +
            '<div><div class="font-serif text-3xl font-bold leading-none">' + fmtNum(res.total) + '</div>' +
            '<div class="text-xs text-slatey mt-1">滿分 ' + fmtNum(res.max) + '</div></div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="flex-1 min-w-[12rem]">' +
          '<p class="font-serif font-bold text-lg">' + esc(info.className) + ' 班 ' + esc(info.seatNo) + ' 號 ' + esc(info.name) + '</p>' +
          '<p class="text-sm text-slatey mt-1">單元：' + esc(res.unit) + '</p>' +
          '<p class="text-sm text-slatey">送出：' + esc(res.submittedAt) + '｜批改：' + esc(res.gradedAt) + '</p>' +
          (res.submissions > 1 ? '<p class="text-xs text-slatey mt-1">你送出過 ' + res.submissions + ' 次，這裡顯示最新一次的結果。</p>' : '') +
          (res.needReview ? '<p class="text-sm mt-2 inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 text-amber-900">👀 這份作答老師會再人工確認，分數可能會調整。</p>' : '') +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      (res.overall ? '<div class="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-paper border border-line p-3 text-sm leading-relaxed"><b>📝 總評：</b><span class="pre-line">' + esc(res.overall) + '</span></div>' : '') +
    '</section>';

    var per = res.per || [];
    if (per.length) {
      html += per.map(function (p) {
        return '<section class="card overflow-hidden">' +
          '<div class="px-4 sm:px-5 py-3 border-b border-line flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">' +
            '<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-ink text-white text-sm font-bold">第 ' + p.no + ' 題</span>' +
            '<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#e9f1ec] text-forest text-sm font-bold score-ring">' + fmtNum(p.score) + '／' + fmtNum(p.max) + ' 分</span>' +
            '<span class="ml-auto text-xs text-slatey">' + esc(p.id) + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3 text-sm leading-relaxed">' +
            (p.text ? '<p class="font-serif text-base font-bold">' + esc(p.text) + '</p>' : '') +
            (p.dims ? '<p class="text-xs text-slatey">評量面向：' + esc(p.dims) + '</p>' : '') +
            (p.feedback ? '<div class="rounded-xl bg-[#f3f7fb] border border-[#d9e2ec] p-3"><b>🤖 AI 回饋：</b><span class="pre-line">' + esc(p.feedback) + '</span></div>' : '') +
            (p.solution ? '<div class="rounded-xl bg-[#eef6f1] border border-[#cfe3d7] p-3"><b>💡 詳解：</b><span class="pre-line">' + esc(p.solution) + '</span></div>' : '') +
          '</div>' +
        '</section>';
      }).join('');
    } else if (res.feedbackText) {
      html += '<section class="card p-5 text-sm leading-relaxed"><b>🤖 AI 回饋</b><p class="pre-line mt-2">' + esc(res.feedbackText) + '</p></section>';
    }
    if (!res.showSolution) html += '<p class="text-xs text-slatey text-center">老師目前沒有開放查看詳解。</p>';
    box.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function handleQuery() {
    var info = {
      unit: $('#qUnit').value,
      className: $('#qClass').value.trim(),
      seatNo: $('#qSeat').value.trim(),
      name: $('#qName').value.trim()
    };
    if (!info.className || !info.seatNo || !info.name) {
      toast('請填寫班級、座號與姓名', 'error');
      (!info.className ? $('#qClass') : !info.seatNo ? $('#qSeat') : $('#qName')).focus();
      return;
    }
    if (state.data && state.data.settings && state.data.settings.queryOpen === false) {
      $('#qResult').innerHTML = '<div class="card p-6 text-center text-slatey">🔒 老師目前尚未開放成績查詢。</div>';
      return;
    }
    storageSet('canvas35_student', JSON.stringify({ c: info.className, s: info.seatNo, n: info.name }));
    setQueryBusy(true);
    var job = IS_GAS
      ? callServer('getMyResult', info)
      : sleep(500).then(function () { return info.unit === DEMO_RESULT.unit ? DEMO_RESULT : { found: false }; });
    job.then(function (res) {
      renderQueryResult(res, info);
    }).catch(function (err) {
      $('#qResult').innerHTML = '<div class="card p-5 text-rose-800 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200">⚠️ ' + esc((err && err.message) || err) + '</div>';
    }).then(function () { setQueryBusy(false); });
  }

  /* ==============================================================
   *  初始化
   * ============================================================== */
  function applyData(data) {
    state.data = data;
    var title = (data.settings && data.settings.title) || '數位手寫與文字探索畫布 3.5';
    $('#appTitle').textContent = title;
    document.title = title;
    if (data.settings && !data.settings.open) $('#closedBanner').classList.remove('hidden');

    var units = unitsOf(data.questions);
    var sel = $('#inUnit');
    sel.innerHTML = units.map(function (u) {
      var n = data.questions.filter(function (q) { return q.unit === u; }).length;
      return '<option value="' + esc(u) + '">' + esc(u) + '（' + n + ' 題）</option>';
    }).join('') || '<option value="">（目前沒有題目）</option>';
    $('#qUnit').innerHTML = units.map(function (u) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(u) + '">' + esc(u) + '</option>';
    }).join('') || '<option value="">（目前沒有單元）</option>';

    $('#loading').classList.add('hidden');
    if (units.length) renderUnit(units[0]);
    setBusy(false);
  }

  function init() {
    try {
      var saved = JSON.parse(storageGet('canvas35_student') || 'null');
      if (saved) { $('#inClass').value = saved.c || ''; $('#inSeat').value = saved.s || ''; $('#inName').value = saved.n || ''; }
    } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }

    $('#inUnit').addEventListener('change', function (e) {
      var target = e.target.value;
      var dirty = state.boards.some(function (b) { return b.hasContent; });
      if (dirty && !state.submitted && !window.confirm('切換單元會清除目前畫布上的作答，確定要切換嗎？')) {
        e.target.value = state.currentUnit;
        return;
      }
      renderUnit(target);
    });

    $('#btnSubmit').addEventListener('click', handleSubmit);
    $('#tabAnswer').addEventListener('click', function () { switchView('answer'); });
    $('#tabQuery').addEventListener('click', function () { switchView('query'); });
    $('#btnQuery').addEventListener('click', handleQuery);
    ['#qClass', '#qSeat', '#qName'].forEach(function (sel) {
      $(sel).addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); handleQuery(); } });
    });
    $('#textOk').addEventListener('click', function () { closeTextModal(true); });
    $('#textCancel').addEventListener('click', function () { closeTextModal(false); });
    $('#textInput').addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) { e.preventDefault(); closeTextModal(true); }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); closeTextModal(false); }
    });
    $('#resultClose').addEventListener('click', function () {
      var m = $('#resultModal');
      m.classList.add('hidden');
      m.classList.remove('flex');
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      var tag = (e.target && e.target.tagName) || '';
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'z' && !/INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(tag)) {
        if (state.activeBoard) { e.preventDefault(); state.activeBoard.undo(); }
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function (e) {
      if (!state.submitted && state.boards.some(function (b) { return b.hasContent; })) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.returnValue = '';
      }
    });

    setBusy(false);

    if (!IS_GAS) {
      $('#modeBadge').classList.remove('hidden');
      $('#previewBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
      applyData(DEMO_DATA);
      return;
    }

    callServer('getInitData').then(applyData).catch(function (err) {
      $('#loading').classList.add('hidden');
      var box = $('#loadError');
      box.classList.remove('hidden');
      box.textContent = '⚠️ 無法載入題目：' + ((err && err.message) || err) + '（請通知老師檢查 SHEET_ID 與工作表設定）';
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

💡 想先看學生端長什麼樣子？可以開啟 ✨ 實際部署的示例，或直接在這裡開啟不用登入的 （預覽模擬模式，內建三題示範題庫）。

步驟四：用選單初始化工作表

  • 回到試算表，按 F5 重新整理，上方會出現「🤖 AI 批改」選單。
  • 點選「🤖 AI 批改」➔「🧱 初始化／修復工作表結構」。第一次執行會要求授權，請選擇自己的帳號並允許。
  • 系統會自動建立三個分頁，並在題庫放入三題示範題目：

    ⚙️系統設定

    開放作答、Gemini 模型、信心度門檻、送出後自動批改、開放成績查詢、查詢時顯示詳解等開關

    ⚙️題庫

    題號、單元名稱、年級、學科、題目、詳解、配分、評分規準、啟用

    📥作答紀錄

    學生送出的作答圖連結、批改狀態、總分、AI 回饋、需人工複核

  • 如果步驟一還沒填金鑰，點「🔑 設定 Gemini API 金鑰」貼上；再點「🧪 測試 Gemini 連線」，看到「✅ 連線成功」就完成了。

步驟五：發布部署

  • 點擊右上角「部署」 ➔ 「新增部署」。
  • 類型選擇「網頁應用程式」。
  • 執行身分選「我」，權限選「所有人」。
  • 部署後，複製網頁應用程式網址給學生。
    ✨ 學生送出的作答圖會存進您的雲端資料夾，並在「📥作答紀錄」新增一列「⏳待批改」。

步驟六：課堂上的 AI 批改流程

  1. 出題：在「⚙️題庫」填入題目、詳解與配分，勾選「啟用」。
  2. 產生規準：點「✨ AI 生成評分規準」，AI 會依年級與學科本質產生 2～3 個評量面向，寫回「評分規準」欄。老師可以直接在儲存格裡修改。
  3. 學生作答：學生開啟網址作答並送出。要收件時，記得在「⚙️系統設定」勾選「開放作答」。
  4. 開始批改：點「🚀 開始 AI 批改（待批改作答）」。份數多時，系統每跑 3.5 分鐘會自動暫停，約 1 分鐘後自動接續，直到全部改完。
  5. 檢查結果：點「📊 檢視批改進度」看各狀態份數。信心度低於門檻的作答會標記「需人工複核」，請老師再看一次。
  6. 學生查成績：學生在網頁上方點「🔍 查詢成績與詳解」，選單元並輸入班級、座號、姓名即可查詢。若不想讓學生先看到詳解，在「⚙️系統設定」取消勾選「查詢時顯示詳解」；要整個關閉查詢，取消勾選「開放成績查詢」。

⚠️ 已經部署過舊版的老師：換上新程式碼後，請到「部署」➔「管理部署作業」➔ ✏️ 編輯 ➔ 版本選「新版本」再部署，網址不變；接著執行一次「🧱 初始化／修復工作表結構」，系統設定才會出現兩個新開關。

💡 想讓學生一送出就自動批改，可在「⚙️系統設定」勾選「送出後自動批改」；需要中途喊停時，點「⏹️ 停止自動接續批改」。

🧰 實用工具

題目轉檔：把考卷、題本的圖片或 PDF 轉成 Markdown，整理好再貼進「⚙️題庫」

版本1 ↗ 版本2 ↗

⚡ 快速複製這套系統

  1. 開啟上方「複製別人的部署」試算表（目前為「僅供檢視」），點「檔案」→「建立副本」，存到自己的雲端硬碟。附在試算表上的 Apps Script 會一起複製過去。
  2. 清掉副本裡別人的作答資料：在「📥作答紀錄」刪除第 2 列以下的資料，保留第 1 列標題。「⚙️題庫」可以換成自己的題目。
  3. 在副本中進入「擴充功能」→「Apps Script」→ ⚙️ 專案設定 →「指令碼屬性」，把 SHEET_ID、FOLDER_ID 改成你自己的試算表與資料夾 ID，GEMINI_API_KEY 換成你自己的金鑰。
  4. 回到試算表按 F5，點「🤖 AI 批改」→「🧱 初始化／修復工作表結構」並完成授權，再點「🧪 測試 Gemini 連線」確認可用。
  5. 重新「新增部署」：網頁應用程式，執行身分選「我」，存取權選「所有人」，把新網址給學生。

✨ 你會發現「⚙️系統設定、⚙️題庫、📥作答紀錄」都已經就緒！學生在前台送出後，作答圖與 AI 批改成績也會自動寫進來。
